messages.subject: Error message after IRTpars = TRUE
parts:
Why do I get an error message when I want to obtain classic IRT item parameters from a multiple group model?

> final.mod<- multipleGroup(data, model = 1, group=group,
+             invariance = c(nms[c(3,4,6:10,12,14:16)], 
+             'free_means', 'free_var'))

> coef(final.mod, simplify=TRUE, IRTpars=TRUE)   
Error in vcov[1L, 1L] : subscript out of bounds

Kind regards,
Berend
